local Service = {}
local Career=require(script.Parent.CareerService)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Balance = require(script.Parent.ProgressionBalance)
local Policy = require(script.Parent.ProgressionPolicy)
local store = not RunService:IsStudio() and game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("CrossgroundsProgression_v1") or nil
local fields = {"XP","Coins","Kills","Deaths","Captures","PlaySeconds","BotKills","TrainingKills"}
local Schema=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ProgressionSchema)
for _,key in Schema.Fields do if not table.find(fields,key) then table.insert(fields,key) end end
for _,mode in Schema.Modes do if mode~="general" then for _,key in Schema.Fields do table.insert(fields,Schema.Key(mode,key)) end end end
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.ProgressionRanking)
local savedFriends={}
local friendResults={}
local state = {}
local friendRate = {}
local function blank()
 local result = {}
 for _, key in fields do result[key] = 0 end
 return result
end
local function clean(source)
 local result = blank()
 if type(source) == "table" then
  for _, key in fields do
   local value = source[key]
   if type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 then result[key] = math.floor(math.min(value, 2^50)) end
  end
 end
 return result
end
local function level(xp)
 return math.floor((xp / 250) ^ (1 / 1.45)) + 1
end
local function publish(player, record)
 if not player.Parent then return end
 for _, key in fields do player:SetAttribute("Progress"..key, record.base[key] + record.pending[key]) end
 local career=Career.Get(player)
 player:SetAttribute("ProgressLevel", career and require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.CareerPolicy).Level(career.cycleXP,career.phase) or level(record.base.XP + record.pending.XP))
 player:SetAttribute("ProgressionReady", record.loaded)
end
local function award(player, amounts, mode, weapon)
 local record = state[player]
 if not record then return end
 if Career.Enabled() and record.loaded then Career.Award(player,amounts,mode,weapon,amounts.XP) end
 for key, value in pairs(amounts) do
  if record.pending[key] and type(value) == "number" and value > 0 then
   record.pending[key] += math.floor(value)
   local modeKey=mode and Schema.Key(mode,key)
   if modeKey and mode~="general" and record.pending[modeKey] then record.pending[modeKey]+=math.floor(value) end
  end
 end
 publish(player, record)
end
local function tick(player)
 local record=state[player] if not record then return end
 local time=os.clock() local elapsed=math.max(0,math.floor(time-record.lastTick))
 record.lastTick+=elapsed
 if elapsed>0 then award(player,{PlaySeconds=elapsed},record.mode) end
 record.mode=player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")
end
function Service.Kill(player,kind,headshot,weapon)
 local amounts=Policy.Reward(kind,headshot)
 award(player,amounts,(kind=="arena" or kind=="training") and "arena" or (kind=="ctf" or kind=="bot") and "ctf" or nil,weapon)
 return amounts.XP
end
function Service.ArenaDeath(player) award(player,{Deaths=1},"arena") end
function Service.ArenaKill(player,headshot) return Service.Kill(player,"arena",headshot) end
function Service.CTFKill(player,isBot,weapon) return Service.Kill(player,isBot and "bot" or "ctf",false,weapon) end
local function save(player)
 local record = state[player]
 if not record or not record.loaded or record.saving then return end
 if Career.Enabled() then
  record.saving=true
  local ok,saved=Career.Flush(player)
  if ok then
   record.base=clean(saved.stats)
   local current=Career.Get(player)
   for _,key in fields do record.pending[key]=math.max(0,(current.stats[key] or 0)-record.base[key]) end
   publish(player,record)
  end
  record.saving=false return
 end
 if RunService:IsStudio() or player.UserId<=0 then return end
 local delta = {}
 local dirty = false
 for _, key in fields do delta[key] = record.pending[key] if delta[key] > 0 then dirty = true end end
 if not dirty and record.visitSaved then Ranking.Index(player.UserId,record.base) return end
 record.saving = true
 local ok, saved = pcall(function()
  return store:UpdateAsync("u" .. player.UserId, function(previous)
   local merged = clean(previous)
   for _, key in fields do merged[key] += delta[key] end
   merged.HasPlayed=true
   return merged
  end)
 end)
 if ok then
  record.visitSaved=true
  record.base = clean(saved)
  for _, key in fields do record.pending[key] = math.max(0, record.pending[key] - delta[key]) end
  publish(player, record)
  Ranking.Index(player.UserId,record.base)
 else
  warn("Crossgrounds progression save: " .. tostring(saved))
 end
 record.saving = false
end
local function watchStats(player, record, folder)
 if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") or record.watched[folder] then return end
 record.watched[folder] = true
 local map = {
  Deaths = {Deaths = 1},
  Captures = {XP = "CTFCaptureXP", Coins = "CTFCaptureCoins", Captures = 1},
 }
 for name, rule in pairs(map) do
  local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
  if value and value:IsA("IntValue") then
   local previous = value.Value
   table.insert(record.connections, value.Changed:Connect(function(newValue)
    local gained = math.max(0, newValue - previous)
    previous = newValue
    if gained == 0 or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") ~= "ctf" then return end
    local amounts = {}
    for key, amount in pairs(rule) do
     amounts[key] = type(amount) == "string" and Balance.Get(amount) * gained or amount * gained
    end
    award(player, amounts,"ctf")
   end))
  end
 end
end
local function added(player)
 if state[player] then return end
 local record = {lastTick=os.clock(),lastSave=os.clock(),mode=player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode"),base = blank(), pending = blank(), loaded = false, saving = false, watched = {}, connections = {}}
 state[player] = record
 table.insert(record.connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CrossgroundsMode"):Connect(function() tick(player) end))
 publish(player, record)
 table.insert(record.connections, player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
  if child.Name == "leaderstats" then watchStats(player, record, child) end
 end))
 watchStats(player, record, player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats"))
 task.spawn(function()
  if Career.Enabled() then
   local data,err=Career.Open(player)
   if not data then player:SetAttribute("ProgressionLoadError",true) return end
   record.base=clean(data.stats) record.visitSaved=true
   Career.Award(player,record.pending)
  elseif not RunService:IsStudio() and player.UserId > 0 then
   local ok, data = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("u" .. player.UserId) end)
   if ok then record.base = clean(data) record.visitSaved=Policy.HasPlayed(data)
   else
    warn("Crossgrounds progression load: " .. tostring(data))
    player:SetAttribute("ProgressionLoadError",true)
    return -- Never overwrite an unread profile with a blank record.
   end
  end
  if state[player] == record then record.loaded = true publish(player, record) Ranking.Index(player.UserId,record.base) end
 end)
end
function Service.Snapshot(player)
 local record=state[player] if not record then return nil end
 local data={userId=player.UserId,name=player.DisplayName,ready=record.loaded}
 for _,key in fields do data[key]=record.base[key]+record.pending[key] end
 local career=Career.Get(player)
 if career then for key,value in Career.Stats(career) do if key:sub(1,6)=="Career" then data[key]=value end end end
 data.Level=career and require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.CareerPolicy).Level(career.cycleXP,career.phase) or level(data.XP) return data
end
function Service.Result(player,mode,won,extra)
 if not Schema.Primary[mode] then return end
 local amounts=table.clone(extra or {})
 amounts[won and "Wins" or "Losses"]=1
 award(player,amounts,mode)
end
function Service.GetOutResult(round)
 if not round or round.progressRecorded then return end
 round.progressRecorded=true
 if round.ending and round.ending:find("technical",1,true) then return end
 local escaped=0
 for p,result in round.status do
  local won=result=="escaped" or result=="beast_contained"
  if won then escaped+=1 end
  if result~="disconnected" then Service.Result(p,"get_out",won,won and {SurvivorWins=1,Escapes=result=="escaped" and 1 or 0} or nil) end
 end
 if round.beast and round.beast.Parent then Service.Result(round.beast,"get_out",escaped==0,escaped==0 and {BeastWins=1} or nil) end
end
local function friends(player)
 local cached=friendResults[player]
 if cached and os.clock()-cached.at<120 then return cached.rows,cached.message end
 local rows={}
 local function row(userId,name,data,isSelf)
  local source=data
  data=clean(data)
  for key,value in source do if key:sub(1,6)=="Career" then data[key]=value end end
  data.userId=userId data.name=name data.self=isSelf==true data.Level=level(data.XP)
  table.insert(rows,data)
 end
 local function live(record)
  local data={HasPlayed=true}
  for _,key in fields do data[key]=record.base[key]+record.pending[key] end
  return data
 end
 if state[player] and state[player].loaded then local p=Career.Get(player) row(player.UserId,player.DisplayName,p and Career.Stats(p) or live(state[player]),true) end
 local ok,pages=pcall(function() return Players:GetFriendsAsync(player.UserId) end)
 local candidates={}
 if ok then
  repeat
   for _,friend in pages:GetCurrentPage() do
    table.insert(candidates,friend) if #candidates>=60 then break end
   end
   if #candidates>=60 or pages.IsFinished then break end
   local advanced=pcall(function() pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync() end)
   if not advanced then break end
  until false
 end
 local function resolve(id)
  if Career.Enabled() then return Career.ReadStats(id) end
  local online=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
  if online and state[online] and state[online].loaded then return live(state[online]) end
  if RunService:IsStudio() then return nil end
  local cached=savedFriends[id]
  if cached and os.clock()-cached.at<120 then return cached.data end
  local read,saved=pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("u"..id) end)
  if not read then return nil end
  local data=Policy.HasPlayed(saved) and saved or nil
  if data then Ranking.Index(id,data) end
  savedFriends[id]={at=os.clock(),data=data}
  return data
 end
 for _,match in Policy.CollectFriends(candidates,resolve,8) do
  row(match.friend.Id,match.friend.DisplayName or match.friend.Username,match.data,false)
 end
 table.sort(rows,function(a,b) if a.XP~=b.XP then return a.XP>b.XP end return a.userId<b.userId end)
 local message="Até 8 amigos com histórico, entre os 60 contatos consultados."
 if not ok then message="Lista de amigos indisponível no momento."
 elseif RunService:IsStudio() then message="Studio: somente amigos presentes nesta sessão. Dados offline exigem servidor publicado."
 elseif #candidates>=60 then message="Até 8 amigos com histórico, entre os 60 contatos consultados." end
 friendResults[player]={at=os.clock(),rows=rows,message=message}
 return rows,message
end
function Service:Start()
 if self.started then return end
 self.started = true
 Career.Start()
 Career.Changed:Connect(function(player) local r=state[player] if r then publish(player,r) end end)
 local remotes = game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.Remotes
 Ranking.Start(Service.Snapshot,friends)
 local profile=remotes:FindFirstChild("GetProgressProfile") or Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
 profile.Name="GetProgressProfile" profile.Parent=remotes
 profile.OnServerInvoke=function(player) return Service.Snapshot(player) end
 local compare = remotes:FindFirstChild("GetFriendProgress") or Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
 compare.Name = "GetFriendProgress"
 compare.Parent = remotes
 compare.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
  local now = os.clock()
  if now - (friendRate[player] or -100) < 20 then return nil, "Aguarde para atualizar o comparativo." end
  friendRate[player] = now
  return friends(player)
 end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(added)
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
  tick(player) save(player)
  if Career.Enabled() then Career.Close(player) end
  local record = state[player]
  if record then for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end end
  state[player] = nil friendRate[player] = nil friendResults[player]=nil
 end)
 for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do added(player) end
 task.spawn(function()
  while true do
   task.wait(2)
   local hub = workspace:FindFirstChild("CrossgroundsPrototype")
   local zone = hub and hub:FindFirstChild("AFKZone")
   for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
    local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local inside = false
    if zone and root and player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") == "hub" then
     local p = zone.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
     inside = math.abs(p.X) <= zone.Size.X/2 and math.abs(p.Y) <= zone.Size.Y/2 and math.abs(p.Z) <= zone.Size.Z/2
    end
    if player:GetAttribute("IsAFK") ~= inside then player:SetAttribute("IsAFK", inside) end
   end
  end
 end)
 task.spawn(function()
  while true do
   task.wait(10)
   for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
    tick(player)
    local record=state[player]
    if record and os.clock()-record.lastSave>=60 then record.lastSave=os.clock() save(player) end
   end
  end
 end)
 game:BindToClose(function()
  for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do tick(player) save(player) end
 end)
end
return Service

local GameManager={}

local active=false local lastReconcile=0 local resultRecorded=false
local Events=game.ReplicatedStorage.Events
function GameManager:Initialize()
 workspace:SetAttribute("RoundState","Lobby")
 Maps:Initialize()
 Flags:Initialize()
end
function GameManager:RunIntermission()
 self.loadReady=false
 workspace:SetAttribute("RoundState","Lobby")
 Display:UpdateTimerInfo(true,true)
 while Player:GetJoinedCount()<Config.MIN_PLAYERS do task.wait(.5) end
 workspace:SetAttribute("RoundState","Countdown")
 Time:StartTimer(Config.INTERMISSION_DURATION)
 Voting:Begin(Config.INTERMISSION_DURATION)
 Display:UpdateTimerInfo(true,false)
 local untilTime=os.clock()+Config.INTERMISSION_DURATION
 while os.clock()<untilTime and Player:GetJoinedCount()>=Config.MIN_PLAYERS do task.wait(.2) end
 local winner=Voting:Finish(Player:GetJoinedCount()<Config.MIN_PLAYERS)
 if Player:GetJoinedCount()>=Config.MIN_PLAYERS then workspace:SetAttribute("RoundState","Loading")end
 if winner then local changed,err=Maps:Load(winner) if changed then Flags:Initialize() elseif err then warn("Mapa: "..err) end end
 if Player:GetJoinedCount()>=Config.MIN_PLAYERS then
  workspace:SetAttribute("RoundState","Loading")
  Time:StartTimer(MapLoadGate.Seconds)
  local safe,mapError=Maps:ValidateSpawns()
  if not safe then
   for _,p in game.Players:GetPlayers() do if p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="ctf" and p:GetAttribute("InMatch") then p:SetAttribute("SceneLoadingError",mapError) end end
  end
  self.loadReady=safe and SceneLoad:Wait(function()
   local list={}for _,p in game.Players:GetPlayers()do if p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="ctf"and p:GetAttribute("InMatch")then table.insert(list,p)end end return list
  end,Maps:SceneRoots(),Maps:SceneAnchors(),function()return Player:GetJoinedCount()>=Config.MIN_PLAYERS end,MapLoadGate.Seconds,true)
  if not self.loadReady and Player:GetJoinedCount()>=Config.MIN_PLAYERS then
   workspace:SetAttribute("RoundState","LoadFailed")
   local retry=workspace:GetAttribute("CTFLoadRetry") or 0
   repeat task.wait(.2) until Player:GetJoinedCount()<Config.MIN_PLAYERS or (workspace:GetAttribute("CTFLoadRetry") or 0)~=retry
  end
 end
end
function GameManager:GameReady() return self.loadReady==true and Player:GetJoinedCount()>=Config.MIN_PLAYERS end
function GameManager:StopIntermission() Display:UpdateTimerInfo(false,false) Display:StopIntermission() end
function GameManager:StartRound()
 Team:ClearTeamScores() Player:ClearPlayerScores()
 resultRecorded=false active=true workspace:SetAttribute("DevelopmentEndCTF",false) workspace:SetAttribute("RoundState","Playing")
 Player:SetGameRunning(true)
 Flags:StartRound() Player:LoadPlayers() Bots:StartRound()
 lastReconcile=os.clock() Time:StartTimer(Config.ROUND_DURATION)
end
function GameManager:Update()
 if os.clock()-lastReconcile>=.5 then Bots:Reconcile() lastReconcile=os.clock() end
end
local function recordResult(winner)
 if resultRecorded or not winner or winner=="Tie" then return end
 resultRecorded=true
 local progress=require(game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.ProgressionService)
 for _,p in game.Players:GetPlayers() do
  if p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="ctf" and p:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
   progress.Result(p,"ctf",p.TeamColor==winner or p.Team==winner or (p.Team and p.Team.Name==tostring(winner)))
  end
 end
end
function GameManager:RoundOver()
 if game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute("DevelopmentEndCTF") then return true end
 local winner=Team:HasTeamWon()
 if winner then recordResult(winner) Display:DisplayVictory(winner) return true end
 if Time:TimerDone() or Player:GetJoinedCount()==0 then
  local result=Team:AreTeamsTied() and "Tie" or Team:GetWinningTeam() recordResult(result) Display:DisplayVictory(result) return true
 end
 return false
end
function GameManager:RoundCleanup()
 active=false workspace:SetAttribute("RoundState","Results")
 Flags:StopRound() Bots:StopRound()
 Player:SetGameRunning(false) Player:SendToLobby()
 task.wait(Config.END_GAME_WAIT)
 Display:DisplayVictory(nil) Team:ClearTeamScores() Team:ShuffleTeams()
end
Events.CaptureFlag.Event:Connect(function(player,color)
 if not active then return end
 if player then Player:AddPlayerScore(player,1) end
 Team:AddTeamScore(color,1) Display:DisplayNotification(color,"Bandeira capturada!")
end)
Events.ReturnFlag.Event:Connect(function(color) if active then Display:DisplayNotification(color,"Bandeira devolvida!") end end)
return GameManager

local TeamManager = {}

-- ROBLOX services
local Teams = game.Teams
local Players = game.Players

-- Game services
local Configurations = require(game.ServerStorage.Configurations)
local DisplayManager = require(script.Parent.DisplayManager)

-- Local variables

local TeamPlayers = {}
local TeamScores = {}
local reservations={}
local reservedBy={}
local AdmissionPolicy=require(game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.TeamAdmissionPolicy)
local capacity=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.GameCatalog):Get("ctf").capacity.combatantsPerTeam
local function teamsOrdered()
 local teams=Teams:GetTeams() table.sort(teams,function(a,b)return a.Name<b.Name end) return teams
end
local function counts()
 local result={}
 for team,list in TeamPlayers do result[team]=#list end
 for _,plan in reservations do for player,team in plan do
  if not table.find(TeamPlayers[team],player) then result[team]=(result[team] or 0)+1 end
 end end
 return result
end

-- Initialization

for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
	TeamPlayers[team] = {}
	TeamScores[team] = 0
end

-- Local Functions

local function GetTeamFromColor(teamColor)
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		if team.TeamColor == teamColor then
			return team
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Public Functions

function TeamManager:ClearTeamScores()
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		TeamScores[team] = 0
		DisplayManager:UpdateScore(team, 0)
	end
end

function TeamManager:HasTeamWon()
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		if TeamScores[team] >= Configurations.CAPS_TO_WIN then
			return team
		end
	end
	return false
end

function TeamManager:GetWinningTeam()
	local highestScore = 0
	local winningTeam = nil
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		if TeamScores[team] > highestScore then
			highestScore = TeamScores[team]
			winningTeam = team
		end
	end
	return winningTeam
end

function TeamManager:AreTeamsTied()
	local teams = Teams:GetTeams()
	local highestScore = 0
	local tied = false
	for _, team in ipairs(teams) do
		if TeamScores[team] == highestScore then
			tied = true
		elseif TeamScores[team] > highestScore then
			tied = false
			highestScore = TeamScores[team]
		end
	end
	return tied
end

function TeamManager:AssignPlayerToTeam(player)
	for team,list in TeamPlayers do if table.find(list,player) then player.Neutral=false player.TeamColor=team.TeamColor return team end end
	local token=reservedBy[player]
	if token and reservations[token] and reservations[token][player] then
	 local team=reservations[token][player]
	 if #TeamPlayers[team]>=capacity then return nil end
	 table.insert(TeamPlayers[team],player) player.Neutral=false player.TeamColor=team.TeamColor return team
	end
	local smallestTeam
	local lowestCount = math.huge
	local occupied=counts()
	for team, playerList in pairs(TeamPlayers) do
		if occupied[team] < capacity and occupied[team] < lowestCount then
			smallestTeam = team
			lowestCount = occupied[team]
		end
	end
	if not smallestTeam then return nil end
	table.insert(TeamPlayers[smallestTeam], player)
	player.Neutral = false
	player.TeamColor = smallestTeam.TeamColor
	return smallestTeam
end

function TeamManager:ReservePlayers(players,sameTeam,token)
 if reservations[token] then return false,"Reserva já existente." end
 local seen={}
 for _,p in players do
  if seen[p] or reservedBy[p] then return false,"Um integrante já possui reserva." end seen[p]=true
  for _,list in TeamPlayers do if table.find(list,p) then return false,"Um integrante já está na partida." end end
 end
 local plan,reason=AdmissionPolicy.Plan(players,sameTeam,teamsOrdered(),counts(),capacity)
 if not plan then return false,reason end
 reservations[token]=plan for p in plan do reservedBy[p]=token end return true
end
function TeamManager:ReleaseReservation(token)
 local plan=reservations[token] if not plan then return end
 for p in plan do if reservedBy[p]==token then reservedBy[p]=nil end end reservations[token]=nil
end

function TeamManager:RemovePlayer(player)
	for _, teamTable in pairs(TeamPlayers) do
		for i = #teamTable, 1, -1 do
			if teamTable[i] == player then
				table.remove(teamTable, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function TeamManager:ShuffleTeams()
 -- Preserve a reservation in progress instead of invalidating its assigned seats.
 if next(reservations) then return end
 local Party=require(game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.PartyService)
 local players={} for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do if p:GetAttribute("InMatch") then table.insert(players,p) end end
 local blocks,seen={},{}
 for _,p in players do
  if not seen[p] then
   local block={p} seen[p]=true local group=Party.Get(p)
   if group and group.sameTeam then for _,other in players do if not seen[other] and table.find(group.members,other.UserId) then table.insert(block,other) seen[other]=true end end end
   table.insert(blocks,block)
  end
 end
 table.sort(blocks,function(a,b)return #a>#b end)
 local teams=teamsOrdered()
 for i=#teams,2,-1 do local j=math.random(i) teams[i],teams[j]=teams[j],teams[i] end
 local plan=AdmissionPolicy.PlanBlocks(blocks,teams,capacity)
 -- Keep the previous valid assignment if whole groups cannot be repacked.
 if not plan then return end
 for _,team in teams do TeamPlayers[team]={} end
 for _,p in players do local team=plan[p] table.insert(TeamPlayers[team],p) p.Neutral=false p.TeamColor=team.TeamColor end
end

function TeamManager:AddTeamScore(teamColor, score)
	local team = GetTeamFromColor(teamColor)
	TeamScores[team] = TeamScores[team] + score
	DisplayManager:UpdateScore(team, TeamScores[team])
end

 BotKillXP = 50, TrainingKillXP = 10,

}
local values={}

-- Local unpublished places have no universe config; use the existing defaults.
if game.GameId~=0 then task.defer(function()
 local ok,result=pcall(function() return game:GetService("ConfigService"):GetConfigAsync() end)
 if not ok then warn("Crossgrounds reward config unavailable; using defaults.") return end
 snapshot=result values={}
 snapshot.UpdateAvailable:Connect(function()
  local refreshed,err=pcall(function() snapshot:Refresh() end)
  if refreshed then values={} else warn("Crossgrounds reward config refresh: "..tostring(err)) end
 end)
end) end
function Balance.Get(key)
 local fallback = assert(defaults[key], "Unknown reward " .. tostring(key))
 if values[key]~=nil then return values[key] end
 if snapshot then
  local success, value = pcall(function() return snapshot:GetValue("Crossgrounds" .. key) end)
  if success and typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value <= 100000 then
   values[key]=math.floor(value)
   return values[key]
  end
 end

end

function Adapter:IsAvailable()
 return not self.failure and workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFInfrastructure")~=nil and workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFLobby")~=nil
end
function Adapter:Start()
 if self.started then return end self.started=true
 PracticeRange:Start()
 self.manager:Initialize()
 workspace:SetAttribute("CTFRoundLoopCount",(workspace:GetAttribute("CTFRoundLoopCount") or 0)+1)
 self.thread=task.spawn(function()
  local ok,err=xpcall(function()
   while self.started do
    repeat self.manager:RunIntermission() until self.manager:GameReady()
    self.manager:StopIntermission() self.manager:StartRound()
    repeat self.manager:Update() task.wait() until self.manager:RoundOver()
    self.manager:RoundCleanup()
   end
  end,debug.traceback)

 end)
end
local function waitReady(player,context,mode)
 local deadline=os.clock()+12
 repeat
  if not player.Parent or context:GetMode(player)~=mode then return false,"A entrada foi interrompida." end
  if player:GetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady") then return true end
  task.wait(.05)
 until os.clock()>deadline
 return false,"O personagem não ficou pronto. Tente novamente."
end
function Adapter:Enter(player)
 if not self:IsAvailable() then return false,"Protótipo CTF indisponível." end
 PracticeRange:Leave(player) player:SetAttribute("CTFPracticeRange",false)
 self.context:SetMode(player,"ctf") self.players:Spawn(player)
 local ready,message=waitReady(player,self.context,"ctf")
 if not ready then return false,message end
 local joined,reason=self.players:Join(player,player:GetAttribute("SelectedKit") or "Regular")
 if not joined then return false,reason end
 return waitReady(player,self.context,"ctf")
end
function Adapter:EnterPractice(player)
 if not self:IsAvailable() then return false,"Protótipo CTF indisponível." end
 if not PracticeRange:Available() then return false,"Boot Camp indisponível para treino." end
 player:SetAttribute("CTFPracticeRange",true) player:SetAttribute("InMatch",false) player:SetAttribute("InArena",false)
 player.Neutral=true player.Team=nil
 local joined,joinError=PracticeRange:Join(player) if not joined then player:SetAttribute("CTFPracticeRange",false) return false,joinError end
 self.context:SetMode(player,"ctf") self.players:Spawn(player)
 local ready,message=waitReady(player,self.context,"ctf")
 if not ready then PracticeRange:Leave(player) player:SetAttribute("CTFPracticeRange",false) return false,message end
 PracticeRange:PlaceCharacter(player,player.Character)
 return true,"Practice Range aberto no Boot Camp. O bot de treino não atira."
end
function Adapter:Leave(player)
 PracticeRange:Leave(player)
 local character=player.Character
 if character then self.flags:DropCarrier(character) self.damage:Unwatch(character) end
 self.voting:RemovePlayer(player)
 self.players:LeaveMatch(player)
 self.context:SetMode(player,"hub")
 self.players:Spawn(player)
 return waitReady(player,self.context,"hub")
end
function Adapter:Snapshot(player)

 if not player:GetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady") then phase="preparing" end
 return {id=self.id,version=self.version,state=phase,round=round,inMatch=player:GetAttribute("InMatch")==true,inArena=player:GetAttribute("InArena")==true,practiceRange=player:GetAttribute("CTFPracticeRange")==true,map=player:GetAttribute("CTFPracticeRange") and "Boot Camp" or workspace:GetAttribute("CurrentMapId") or "riverside"}
end
